$comment: Persistent variant — adds SessionStart hook that loads SAD context every session. Generated by sad-init --persistent. Merge keys with your existing .claude/settings.json; do not overwrite.

hooks.command: cat AGENTS.md .sad/rules/core/README.md .sad/state/sad-state.md 2>/dev/null; echo '---'; head -n 80 .sad/memory/constitution.md 2>/dev/null; echo '---'; bash .sad/scripts/next-step.sh 2>/dev/null || true
